entries.body: Stages1-3 in invoice/core.py: tax 10% (0 if tax_exempt is True); tier discount gold5%/silver2%; line amount qty*price, x0.90 if qty>=100; exact line amounts, round subtotal/discount/tax half-even, total=sum of rounded; format_money NZ$/A$/US$, comma thousands, ValueError else, -prefix negatives (half-even).
